name: explore
description: Agent-selected discovery, reads, and relationship expansion with reusable source references

outputSchema.targets: array - ranked locations with match reasons and reusable refs
outputSchema.evidence: array - explicitly selected whole source ranges only
outputSchema.deferred: array - source which did not fit, never silently truncated
outputSchema.unresolved: array - missing static links or HTTP prefix evidence
outputSchema.results: array - per-query ranked results for a batch

notes: Discovery ranks issue words lexically by default; hybrid uses a ready index or reports fallback
Search retains literal semantics; use discovery to recover from a zero-hit phrase
Copy refs into selected reads or follows; inspect source and verify actual wiring
Re-search after edits; stale references or IDs are rejected
